info.name: Chaos Mesh Dashboard Archives Events API

params.name: object_id
params.description: Filter events by the UID of the associated experiment or workflow.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: end
params.description: Filter events up to this timestamp (RFC3339).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return.

items.docs: Returns a list of chaos experiment events from the Chaos Mesh event store. Events record state transitions and fault injection activities. Results can be filtered by object UID, namespace, name, kind, and time range.
Returns a specific chaos event by its integer ID.

info.name: Chaos Mesh List events for a workflow

items.docs: Returns all events associated with a specific workflow and its related child experiments by the workflow UID.

params.name: objectId
params.description: UID of the object (experiment, workflow, or schedule) to filter events by.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to filter results by. If omitted, returns results from all namespaces.

params.name: name
params.description: Name substring to filter results by.

params.name: kind
params.description: Chaos type kind to filter by, such as PodChaos, NetworkChaos, IOChaos, StressChaos, HTTPChaos, TimeChaos, DNSChaos, or KernelChaos.

params.name: type
params.description: Event type filter, e.g., Normal or Warning.

items.docs: Returns a list of events generated by chaos experiments, workflows, and schedules. Events capture state transitions, errors, and lifecycle changes. Can be filtered by object ID, namespace, name, kind, and type.
